title: Overlapping placement: absolute positioning, z-index and coloured panels
stressor: absolutely-positioned overlapping text, z-index, text over coloured panels, non-cell-aligned offsets
notes: Self-contained single page, all CSS inline, no script, no network URLs. Designed for a 960x640 viewport (120x40 at 8x16). An Acid2-style placement stress: ten absolutely-positioned text boxes at known px coordinates. Boxes overlap with explicit z-index ordering (a light blue background block under an amber foreground box), and text sits over solid coloured panels (dark, red, green, blue strip) so foreground-versus-background contrast varies. Two labels use deliberately non-cell-aligned offsets (left:13px/top:27px and left:333px/top:411px) to stress sub-cell binning. Short English labels make placement easy to verify. White-ish light background. Content is original.
